identification: Box of reference books: (1) Garnett and Gosse, English Literature: An Illustrated Record, 4 vols, William Heinemann, London (first published 1903-04), publishers red cloth, gilt spines, vol III has a chipped head of spine, vol I title page shows Henry VIII seal; vol 4 title-page plate is a Chaucer manuscript facsimile. (2) The Oxford Library of English Usage, 3 vols in slipcase (Grammar, Spelling, Usage). (3) The Oxford Library of Words and Phrases, 3 vols in slipcase (Quotations, Proverbs, Word Origins). Oxford sets are c.1990 reprint sets, very common.

viewing_check: Estimate 30-40, no bid yet. Check the printing year on the Heinemann title pages, spine and cloth condition (vol III spine chip), whether all 4 volumes are the same set and that plates are intact. Heinemann cloth sets have sold at about A$29-73, the Oxford pair at about A$39-57 combined, so the box is worth roughly A$70-130 retail before postage, but each set is heavy. Prices mostly 1-2 years old, flat.
